sentences.text: Allowed subject to all just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.
1. This is a petition seeking quashing of the FIR No. 792/2014 dated 13.12.2014 registered under Section 406/498A/34 IPC at PS Anand Vihar.

2. The parties have arrived at a settlement dated 12.03.2020 before the learned Family Court,
Karkardooma Courts, Delhi, pursuant to which, the petitioner was to pay a total sum of Rs. 20 lakhs to the respondent No.2.
A sum of Rs. 10 lakhs has already been paid and the balance sum of Rs. 10 lakhs has been paid today vide DD No. 564308 dated 27.04.2023 drawn on SBI.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/09/2023 at 11:02:50 3.
There is a minor child who is in the care and custody of the respondent No.2.
In the settlement, it is stated that the petitioner shall pay a sum of Rs. 10,000/- per month towards the expenses of the minor child till he attains the age of 21 years.

5. The same is contrary to the Honble Supreme Courts judgment in 'Ganesh vs. Sudhirkumar Srivastava' [(2020) 20 SCC 787].
6.

The petitioner and the respondent No.2 state that the child shall have all rights of inheritance,
maintenance, education, marriage etc. against either of the parents.
The statement of the petitioner and respondent No.2 in this regard is taken on record.

7. It is directed that the settlement and this order shall not come in way of the minor child claiming his rights of inheritance, maintenance, education, marriage etc. against either of the parties in accordance with law.
